mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT cm.* FROM course_materials cm JOIN material_links l ON l.material_id = cm.material_id AND l.course_id = #{courseId} WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY material_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE course_materials SET page_count = #{pageCount} WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT cm.* FROM course_materials cm WHERE cm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cm.extraction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material_analysis_jobs j WHERE j.material_id = cm.material_id AND j.job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND j.course_id = 0 AND j.analysis_version = #{analysisVersion} AND (cm.file_hash IS NULL OR j.file_hash = cm.file_hash)) ORDER BY cm.material_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_materials SET file_hash = #{fileHash} WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash IS NULL
